answer: Work waits on the anchor until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mirror of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
